data.one_liner: OrderTracker widget builds a multi‑step order status UI with animated transitions.
data.what_it_does: It displays order progress stages (placed, shipped, out for delivery, delivered) using a vertical timeline. The widget accepts lists of TextDto for each stage and colors for active/inactive states.
use_when: You need a ready‑made order tracking UI for e‑commerce apps
You want to avoid custom animation code for status steps
avoid_when: You require custom layout beyond the provided stages
You need to integrate with a state‑management solution that expects custom widgets
weaknesses: Limited customization of the timeline design
No support for dynamic stage addition at runtime
No code generation or state‑management integration
data.setup_notes: Add dependency in pubspec.yaml, import package, provide lists of TextDto.

alternatives.name: flutter_animate
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides more flexible animation options for custom widgets

alternatives.name: lottie
alternatives.why_pick_it: Allows using Lottie animations for status icons
